name: Elote

ingredients.name: sweetcorn on the cob, husks removed

steps: Remove all silk from the corn and pat dry. Use 4 medium cobs weighing about 800 g together. Brush with oil and heat a grill pan over medium-high heat.
Grill corn for 15 minutes, turning every few minutes, until kernels are tender with scattered charred spots.
Mix mayonnaise, sour cream, lime juice and salt into a creamy spread. Place crumbled cheese on a plate.
Coat hot corn evenly with the spread, roll or sprinkle with cheese and dust with chilli powder. Serve immediately.
tips: Choose cotija labelled vegetarian and eggless mayonnaise. Add the creamy coating only after grilling.
notes: Quantities serve four adults. Check the doneness cues in each step and adjust seasoning to taste. Jain suitability depends on your household ingredient rules.
